topic: The Metal Snake month in the Fire Horse year. The year's most inauspicious elemental combination, its risks, who it hits hardest, and which days actually favor you.

images.concept: The Metal Snake itself, rendered literally: an antique brass serpent coiled on dark wood beside a single candle flame. Metal meeting fire, the month's core tension, as one evocative object.
images.prompt: A cinematic wide still life, 16:9 aspect ratio. A beautifully crafted antique brass serpent, coiled tight with finely detailed metal scales, rests on aged dark walnut wood. A single candle flame burns close beside the coiled metal snake, its warm light catching the polished scales and throwing the coil into deep relief. The flame is the only light source. Deep midnight jade shadows frame the edges. A faint wisp of smoke drifts upward. The mood is quiet intensity and elemental tension, metal meeting fire. No people, no text, no symbols. Palette: antique gold and brass, copper highlights, midnight jade shadow, warm amber candlelight. Intimate, museum-quality lighting. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A woman standing in profile at a window during a heavy overcast day, not moving forward, just watching the weather outside. The mood is patient and deliberate: holding still while the world outside is charged.
images.prompt: A woman stands in profile at a tall window, arms loosely crossed, looking out at an overcast sky. She is neither distressed nor serene. She is watchful, deliberate, at rest in her own stillness. Her silhouette is soft and warm. The room behind her is dim, lit only by the diffuse grey light from outside. Curtains frame the window on either side. The feeling is the pause before a decision. Not fear, but patience. Palette: warm ivory interior against a cool grey sky, dusty rose fabric. Film-still quality. Women never face camera directly. No text in image. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A coiled ornate metal snake beside a single lit candle on dark aged wood. The elemental tension of the month expressed as an object still life.
images.prompt: A square still life: a beautifully crafted metal snake figurine (antique brass, coiled tight, detailed scales) rests on aged dark walnut wood beside a single lit taper candle. The candle flame is the only light source. Deep shadows frame the composition. A faint wisp of smoke rises. The feeling is quiet intensity, an ancient object carrying meaning. No text, no astrology symbols, no generic stock elements. Palette: antique gold, deep shadow, warm amber candlelight. Close, intimate framing. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A pen resting on an open journal with a single unfinished sentence. The moment of choosing to tell the truth versus the edited version.
images.prompt: A wide-format composition: warm aged parchment fills the frame. In the center, hand-inked brush lettering in deep walnut ink reads: "The Snake notices everything." Two lines, centered. The lettering is confident and clear, modern calligraphy, not cursive. A faint tea-stain halo in the lower right corner. Deckle edges visible on the sides. One small ink flourish beneath the text. The overall mood is intimate, like a page from a private journal. Palette: warm cream, walnut brown ink. No decorative borders or Western zodiac symbols. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: Overhead flat lay of an open journal beside a mahjong tile face-down and an ink brush. The moment before writing the true thing.
images.prompt: Square overhead flat lay on dark walnut wood. An open journal shows blank cream pages. No writing yet, just intention. An ink brush rests diagonally across the left page. One mahjong tile sits face-down to the right of the journal, its back detail visible but not identifiable. A small porcelain tea cup, empty, is in the upper corner. Morning natural light from above. The composition has breathing room. Not cluttered. Palette: warm ivory journal, dark wood, antique gold tile back, soft sage tea cup. No text readable, no symbols legible. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.
